note: Next-trading-day forecast for Monday 11-30, the last session of November, written Friday evening after the half day. First file written with gap buckets (if_gap): the gap is unknown until 09:30, so each bucket carries its own close-above-open and size claim, and only the bucket that happens is scored (the others are void). The morning file reads the bucket and revises only for news.

environment.label: A pullback under the 200-day (SPY 728.32, -0.4% under it, -5.7% on the month, -6.5% from its one-year high); realized volatility 32% (20 days) against 15% over a year, 11 of the last 20 sessions moved 1% or more; AI names moving together (0.86 correlation over 20 days against 0.54 before); defensive groups ahead of tech over the month (+4.1% against -17.2%) and, this week, too (+2.9% against -0.2%); stocks and bonds moving against each other (-0.20); 4 of the last 6 gaps closed against their direction.
environment.near: 25 days in 7 episodes since 2004 sat this close to today on trend, distance from the high and volatility: six sessions later SPY was up on 50% of them (episodes 33%), 24 sessions later 46% (episodes 50%), and on 32% it closed 3% or more lower within six sessions. Seven episodes: context, not a number to lean on.

movement.seen: Two sessions against the month: 11-25 filled a 2.2% gap (SMH +4.9% open to close) and 11-27 gapped +1.3% and closed +0.34% from the open on the half day, with MU +2.7% and WDC +2.5% but NVDA -0.9% on the export-control headline. The week: SPY +1.7%, defensives still ahead (XLV +3.8%, XLY +3.5%, XLP +3.1% against SMH -1.7%, XLK -0.3%).
movement.turn_if: Unchanged from the 11-27 file, checked at the 12-04 close: SMH above its 11-25 low (393.88; now 440.06) and closing above its 10-day average, XLP and XLV lagging SPY over the week.
movement.watch: Monday is month end (rebalancing flows; after a -5.7% month for SPY and -10% for QQQ, pension rebalancing is usually read as a buyer of stocks, a story I have no count for here). The week: ISM manufacturing and Marvell's report Tuesday 12-01, Salesforce Wednesday 12-02, the November jobs report Friday 12-04; Broadcom 12-09 and Oracle 12-14 inside ten trading days (R3 windows for those names); Fed 12-09 and CPI 12-10 the week after; Fed speakers silent from 11-28.

forecast.expected_gap: Unknown: the weekend carries the Nvidia export-control story, any China reply, and Asia's Monday. Friday's half day closed +0.34% from its open; there is no weekend print to read. Hence the buckets.
forecast.by_gap: SPY close above its open, 2004-2026 daily bars (5,251 days; 785 with 20-day volatility at 22% or more the evening before). Gap under -1%: 49% all days, 44% in high volatility (36% in 2004-15, 57% in 2016-26), 47% with the month down -> 0.48. Gap -1% to -0.3%: 55% all, 52% high volatility, 41% near the 200-day (44 days), 33% on high-volatility Mondays (30 days) -> 0.50. Gap within 0.3%: 53% all, 51% high volatility, 56% near the 200-day -> 0.52. Gap +0.3% to +1%: 55% all, 52% high volatility, 70% on high-volatility Mondays (30 days) -> 0.54. Gap +1% or more: 60% all, 62% high volatility, 64% with the month down, but 48% near the 200-day (23 days) -> 0.57. Each number moves 5-15 points with how the days are drawn; none carries a call by itself (pre-market step 3).
forecast.size: Open to close under 1%, high-volatility days by gap: 36%, 61%, 71%, 61%, 47%; today's 32% volatility sits well above the 22% line those days start at, so each is shaded down 5 points or so: 0.35, 0.55, 0.65, 0.55, 0.45.
forecast.level: Close above Friday's 728.32: 0.52 (high-volatility days closed above the previous close about half the time; the gap decides most of it and is unknown).
forecast.range: 80% range for Monday's close 710-747: one day of 32% volatility is about 2.0%, times 1.28 either side of 728.32.
forecast.wrong_if: A one-sided weekend: a clear Nvidia or China escalation (gap under -1% with futures still falling at 09:00) or a broad relief (gap over +1% with chips leading and bonds quiet) makes the bucket numbers stale; the morning file then writes a revision beside these before 09:30.

overnight: No directional position over the weekend: the direction is near a coin flip and two days of 32% volatility is a ±3% spread. Nothing is carried (the KO and WMT sniper shadows expired 11-27).
scoring: At the 11-30 evening round: the claims of the bucket that happened, the level and the range; the other buckets are void. --summary sets this evening word against the morning's last before the open.
zh: 周一（11 月最后一个交易日）：周末消息多（英伟达出口限制、中国可能的回应），开盘跳空无法提前知道，所以按跳空分档写：低开超过 1%，收在开盘价上方 0.48；低开 0.3% 到 1%：0.50；平开：0.52；高开 0.3% 到 1%：0.54；高开超过 1%：0.57。全都接近一半一半，不下注。开到收在 1% 以内：低开大 0.35、平开 0.65、高开大 0.45。收在周五 728.32 上方：0.52。周一收盘 80% 区间 710–747。周末不拿方向单。这周要看：周二 ISM 和 Marvell 财报，周三 Salesforce，周五非农。
